name: PLA
summary: Standard polymer ideal for rapid dimensional validation, early-stage fit checks, and concept models with clean geometric detail.
characteristics: Clean geometric detail, low shrinkage, rigid mechanical profile, cost-effective rapid iteration
use_cases: Concept verification models, architectural prototypes, visual assembly fits, non-load jigs & fixtures
chemical: Moderate resistance to oils and greases; sensitive to high moisture, ketones, and heat
slicing: 0.12 - 0.28 mm layer height, 15-100% infill, recommended 3+ perimeter walls

name: PETG
summary: Versatile engineering thermoplastic combining high interlayer cohesion with enhanced impact strength, chemical resistance, and low moisture absorption for functional parts.
characteristics: Superior layer adhesion, impact resilience, water-tight printing, high chemical endurance
use_cases: Electronic enclosures, fluid containment prototypes, mechanical brackets, snap-fit assemblies, chemical ducting
chemical: High resistance to water, dilute acids, alkalis, oils, and mechanical greases
slicing: 0.16 - 0.28 mm layer height, 20-50% gyroid infill, recommended 4 perimeter walls

name: ABS
summary: Standard engineering thermoplastic engineered for mechanical impact strength, thermal resilience up to 85°C, and structural machinability for functional prototypes.
characteristics: High impact toughness, thermal endurance, rigid structure, vapor post-processable
use_cases: Functional gearboxes, competition robot chassis, mechanical brackets, snap-fit enclosures
chemical: Resistant to aqueous solutions, dilute acids, and alkalis; soluble in acetone and esters
slicing: 0.16 - 0.24 mm layer height, heated enclosure calibrated, recommended 4 perimeter walls

name: ASA
summary: Matches the mechanical strength of ABS while offering high resistance to UV degradation and outdoor weathering for exterior field hardware.
characteristics: High UV stability, weather endurance, impact resistance comparable to ABS, matte surface finish
use_cases: Outdoor telemetry enclosures, exterior drone airframes, marine sensor housings, solar mount fixtures
chemical: Good resistance to UV exposure, environmental moisture, rain, oils, and dilute acids
slicing: 0.16 - 0.24 mm layer height, heated enclosure calibrated, recommended 4 perimeter walls

name: TPU
summary: High-durability thermoplastic elastomer with extreme tear resistance, elongation capacity, and vibration damping. Calibrated for functional gaskets and shock absorption.
characteristics: Shore 95A elasticity, extreme abrasion resistance, acoustic & vibration damping, tear strength
use_cases: Industrial sealing gaskets, vibration dampers, protective drone bumpers, flexible couplers, robot gripper pads
chemical: Exceptional resistance to hydrocarbon oils, greases, lubricants, and mild industrial solvents
slicing: 0.16 - 0.24 mm layer height, 15-40% gyroid infill, direct-drive calibration at 30 mm/s

name: PC
summary: High-temperature engineering thermoplastic delivering exceptional impact toughness, high tensile strength, and heat resistance up to 115°C for demanding functional prototypes.
characteristics: High impact resistance, 115°C thermal threshold, structural rigidity, dielectric insulation
thermal: Continuous operating temperature up to 110°C, heat deflection up to 115°C (0.45 MPa)
use_cases: High-impact drone guards, functional gears, structural mounting brackets, protective safety covers, heat-exposed electronic housings
chemical: Resistant to mineral acids, neutral oils, and greases; sensitive to ketones, esters, and aromatic solvents
slicing: 0.16 - 0.24 mm layer height, 270-300°C extrusion, enclosed chamber calibrated, 4+ perimeter walls

name: PA-CF
summary: Nylon (PA6) reinforced with 20% chopped carbon fibers. Delivers high mechanical stiffness, high strength-to-weight ratio, and thermal stability.
characteristics: Extreme structural stiffness, lightweight aluminum replacement, low thermal warpage, matte carbon finish
thermal: Heat deflection up to 150°C under mechanical load
use_cases: High-speed drone airframes, robotics structural arms, motor mount brackets, functional racing components
chemical: High resistance to engine oils, gasoline, lubricants, and organic industrial solvents
slicing: 0.16 - 0.24 mm layer height, hardened steel nozzle, 30-100% infill, recommended 4+ walls

name: PAHT-CF
summary: High-temperature nylon reinforced with chopped carbon fibers. Features thermal resistance up to 194°C HDT, high Z-axis layer adhesion, and dimensional stability under load.
characteristics: 194°C heat deflection, outstanding Z-axis layer strength, low moisture absorption vs standard nylon, high rigidity
thermal: Continuous operating temperature up to 150°C, heat deflection up to 194°C under 0.45 MPa load
use_cases: Formula SAE / competition brackets, high-load drone airframes, industrial tooling jigs, autoclave fixtures, functional mechanical gears
chemical: High resistance to motor oils, gasoline, coolants, hydrocarbons, and workshop cleaning solvents
slicing: 0.16 - 0.24 mm layer height, 280-300°C extrusion, hardened nozzle required, 4+ perimeter walls

name: PPA-CF
summary: High-temperature PPA composite reinforced with chopped carbon fibers. Features thermal resistance up to 215°C HDT and high mechanical stiffness under thermal load.
characteristics: 215°C thermal resistance, high flexural modulus (9.8 GPa), minimal moisture uptake, high chemical resistance
thermal: High heat deflection up to 215°C for continuous high-temperature service
use_cases: Formula SAE engine air intakes, UAV motor mounts, high-temp fluid manifolds, aggressive chemical valves
chemical: Highly resistant to engine oils, radiator coolants, brake fluids, and strong organic solvents
slicing: 0.16 - 0.20 mm layer height, 300°C+ extrusion, heated chamber calibrated, 5+ walls

name: PA-GF
summary: Nylon (PA6) reinforced with chopped glass fibers. Provides mechanical rigidity, electrical insulation, and resistance to friction, abrasion, and wear.
characteristics: High dimensional stability, dielectric insulation, abrasion resistance, mechanical rigidity
thermal: Heat deflection up to 130°C under continuous load
use_cases: Precision tooling fixtures, slide guide blocks, non-conductive electrical brackets, wear plates
chemical: Exceptional resistance to industrial chemicals, hydraulic fluids, grease, and hydrocarbons
slicing: 0.16 - 0.24 mm layer height, hardened steel nozzle, recommended 4 perimeter walls
